title: Generate an app CHANGELOG entry
description: Generate a per-app changelog entry from the app's own commits, and optionally commit it as the release marker.

examples.description: Print the rendered changelog entry to the console without writing or committing.
Write the changelog entry and commit it as the 'chore(release)' release marker.

project.description: The app to release (Nx project name).

releaseVersion.description: The new version, e.g. 1.2.0 (semver recommended to match existing tags). Named releaseVersion because Nx reserves the --version flag.

from.description: Override the boundary ref (git tag or SHA). Defaults to the last 'chore(release): <project>' commit, then the last commit that touched the app's CHANGELOG, then the first commit for a first release.

preview.description: Print the rendered changelog entry to the console without writing or committing.

commit.description: After writing, stage and commit only the CHANGELOG as 'chore(release): <project> <version>'. Off by default; the generator just writes the file.
